title: Pikachu: The Culinary Electrician
premise: Explore how Pikachu uses its electric abilities to tenderize food, elevating its skill set beyond simple battles.
audiencePromise: Discover Pikachu's clever use of electricity in cooking, supported by its natural traits and habits.
openLoop: How does Pikachu use electricity to prepare food?
payoff: Pikachu cleverly uses its stored electricity to roast tough berries, making them easier and more delicious to eat.
engagementQuestion: Is Pikachu a survivalist or a chef?

voice.instructions: Engaging and playful with a hint of wonder.

scenes.headline: Pikachu, the Electric Chef
scenes.narration: Meet the Pokémon that cooks with shocks!
scenes.caption: Culinary Pikachu at Work

scenes.headline: Electric Berry Roasting
scenes.narration: Pikachu roasts hard berries with electricity.
scenes.caption: Making tough berries tender—electric-style!

scenes.headline: Cheeky Power
scenes.narration: Stores electricity in cheek sacs for cooking bursts.
scenes.caption: Its cheeks: more than just cute.

scenes.headline: Berry Blackening Skills
scenes.narration: Sometimes, Pikachu overcooks berries, charring them.
scenes.caption: Oops! A bit too much zap.

scenes.headline: Efficiency or Taste?
scenes.narration: Does Pikachu cook for survival or flavor?
scenes.caption: Electricity adds flavor or just practicality?

scenes.headline: Survivalist or Chef?
scenes.narration: Is Pikachu a survivalist or a chef? You decide.
scenes.caption: Chef or survivalist? You be the judge.
